citationText: In the following references, Journal indicates Journal of the SMPTE . “New Prod., Journal…” refers to the New Products column—brief items describing recent products, developments and inventions. This column appears in each issue of the Journal with the exception of the May and December issues. “Ed. Ind. News, Journal…” refers to the Education, Industry News column, another regular feature of the Journal . In addition to news about developments in education and industry, this column also contains news about individual members of the SMPTE, activities of other societies and other items of general interest.
